provenance.description: top-down view of a red-orange danger warning circle painted on a cafe floor: a thick wide oval ring outline made of short bold dashes with a thin bright inner line, the center completely empty and transparent, pixel art, transparent background
provenance.animationAction: ring glowing and pulsing brighter while the dashes slowly rotate around the circle in a seamless loop

runtime.fitRule: ZoneTelegraphV2: outer ring per-axis = 2r x 2r; inner copy scales 0→1 over the telegraph time (reaches the edge exactly at activation)

postprocess: PixelLab filled the center with a wood floor despite the prompt; interior cleared by flood fill from center stopping at the bright ring pixels, then loose specks removed. .aseprite keeps the original output.

frames.postprocess: largest component; interior (wood floor) cleared by 4-way flood fill from center stopping at bright red/orange ring pixels; then removed specks not connected to the ring
